key_inclusion_criteria: not achieving diabetes management goals and requiring treatment intensification
evidence: The study enrolled 36 outpatients with type 2 diabetes mellitus who were receiving dietary and exercise therapy plus oral hypoglycemic agents but had not achieved their diabetes management goals and required treatment intensification. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
Overall mean age was 62.1 ± 12.7 years; 24 of 36 participants were men (66.7%), corresponding to 33.3% women. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

arms.name: IGlarLixi group
evidence: Participants were randomized 1:1 to the IGlarLixi group or IDegLira group, with 18 participants in each group. Injection therapy was started after the baseline monitoring period. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
The article identifies IGlarLixi as a fixed-ratio combination of basal insulin and a GLP-1 receptor agonist. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

arms.name: IDegLira group
evidence: Participants were randomized 1:1 to the IGlarLixi group or IDegLira group, with 18 participants in each group. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

outcomes.name: Time in range (TIR)
outcomes.unit: % of time in target glucose range (70–180 mg/dL)
evidence: TIR was explicitly defined as the primary efficacy endpoint. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=
At 18 weeks, TIR was 78.3 ± 15.3% in the IGlarLixi group and 75.7 ± 19.0% in the IDegLira group, with between-group P = 0.431. :chatgpt-content-reference{index=

outcomes.name: Time below range (TBR) level 1
